description: Normative Place.kind vocabulary and custodian internality of acceptance fixtures (contracts/fixture-place-kinds.md). Aligned with the product vocabulary of docs/execution/s2-inventory/contracts.md (moveQuantity) and the read-only custody rule of backend QualityEligibility.custody/FulfillmentCommands.requireWarehouse. ./verify prepare (ContractValidator.placeKindProblems) rejects a fixture Place without a kind, a kind outside this list and an internal-storage segment without an internal custodian.
productRefs: docs/execution/s2-inventory/contracts.md (moveQuantity: both Place.kind INTERNAL_STORAGE and a confirmed internal custodian)

backend/src/main/java/com/mulino/application/quality/QualityEligibility.java (custody: INTERNAL_STORAGE+internal custodian CONFIRMED; TRANSIT/CUSTOMER/SUPPLIER/EXTERNAL_* OUTSIDE; any other kind UNRECOGNIZED -> UNKNOWN, eligible 0)
backend/src/main/java/com/mulino/domain/inventory/InventoryRepository.java (internalCustodian: an actor of the organization of kind HUMAN or AGENT)

kinds.meaning: Controlled internal storage of the fixture organization (warehouse). Stock here is in confirmed custody only when its segment names an internal custodian; only then can other conditions make it sale/dispatch eligible.
In transport (vessel, truck, carrier leg). Held history, never sale-eligible stock; eligibility is a known 0.
A customer's place (delivered or customer site). Outside internal custody; eligibility is a known 0.
A supplier's or origin place before handover. Outside internal custody; eligibility is a known 0.
A port, customs or bonded area outside internal custody (declared EXTERNAL_* kind). Eligibility is a known 0.

unrecognizedKindControl.meaning: Explicit negative control: the Place deliberately carries a kind outside this vocabulary (not starting with EXTERNAL_) so the case can assert that the product reports eligibility UNKNOWN with eligible 0 instead of a known 0 or a positive quantity. Only allowed with that kind; a fixture never relies on an undeclared kind.
